name: Lee Sin-young
bio:
Lee Sin-young (이신영) is a South Korean actor born on January 24, 1998, in Chilgok County, South Korea. He began his career in web dramas in 2018 before gaining international recognition for his breakout performance in the hit romantic drama series Crash Landing on You (2019–2020).

Lee subsequently starred in leading and prominent roles across various television series, including How to Buy a Friend (2020), Awaken (2020–2021), Rookie Cops (2022), Dr. Romantic Season 3 (2023), and Captivating the King (2024). On the big screen, he made his feature film debut leading the ensemble cast of the acclaimed sports drama film Rebound (2023).

credits.title: Tristes Tropiques
credits.overview: A group of young assassins, trained by the rainforest's absolute ruler known as 'Master' and affiliated with the organization 'Tristes Tropiques,' struggle with mutual distrust as they vow to exact bloody revenge.

credits.title: Run to You
credits.overview: A veteran sprinter who is getting one last opportunity to re-kindle the love of his life, and a happy-go-lucky high schooler who pulls out all the stops to win over the love of Ji-eun.

credits.title: Rebound
credits.overview: This true story retells the incredible tale of the 2012 National High School Basketball Championship, in which a new coach and six players from the weakest basketball team ran nonstop for eight days.
